title: What AI meeting notes really cost
dek: The pricing page shows the annual number; the monthly one is often double, and the free tier has a catch. I lined up thirteen vendors, then priced the alternative: buy once and pay for tokens yourself.
description: Thirteen AI notetakers priced side by side, monthly and annual, with the free-tier catches, plus the token arithmetic for bringing your own AI key.
og_headline: What AI meeting notes really cost
og_subtitle: Thirteen pricing pages, the free-tier catches, and the token arithmetic for paying the AI company yourself.
